prepare_pt2e_model_for_calibration: prepare a llama model for PT2E quantization calibration by exporting and inserting observers
load_pt2e_quantized_model: load a pre-quantized PT2E model from a .pt2 file for inference on HPU
save_pt2e_quantized_model: convert a calibrated PT2E model and save it as a .pt2 file after calibration
configure_pt2e_quantization: configure PT2E quantization with int8 or fp8 data types using the PT2EConfig dataclass
review_qdtype_dict: review the qdtype_dict mapping quantization keys like int8 and fp8 to torch dtype values
